datasets: Twitter data from Pro-ED, Keto & Diet, Body Image, Anti-ED, Healthy Lifestyle & Weight Loss, and Weight Loss Drugs communities
answer_1.outputs: Synthetic tweets mimicking target online communities

answer_2.quote: We compute the semantic embeddings of D_i, D_ft_i, and D_context_i using BERTweet. We then measure the distance between these embeddings using the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID).

answer_3.quote: We train a classifier to determine the community from which a tweet originated by finetuning Llama-3 using demonstrations ... We classify the finetuned LLM-generated tweets ...

answer_4.quote: An annotator with expertise in EDs on social media was presented with 300 triplets ... For each triplet, the annotator was asked to decide which tweet was more aligned with the given community, by referring to the following characteristics: mis/use of ingroup language, references to themes in underlying distribution (e.g. the Body Image community often references nudity), use of capitalization, and coherence of message.
answer_4.guideline: Decide which tweet (from LLM-Context or finetuned LLM) is more aligned with the community based on specific characteristics.
